name: Aiuchi Shuuta
source:
A 2nd year student at Hokumaki Academy

He is a prodigy who scores the highest on every exam.
He is cynical and has no friends. 
He lives alone.

[Translated from the [url=https://glovety.product.co.jp/]official site[/url]]
